title: [SST] Vocaloid Discs
description: Changes some of Minecraft's Music Discs to Vocaloid Songs.
body:
The Vocaloid Discs recource pack changes some of the Minecraft Music Disc textures and songs to some Vocaloid songs.

This is the list of current songs that are added:
- [[MIMI - Science](https://youtu.be/m-bvW4pKT68)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Cat]
  - Singer: Kasane Teto SV
- [[32ki - Mesmerizer](https://youtu.be/19y8YTbvri8)]
  - Replaces [C418 - 13]
  - Singers: Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto SV
- [[Tsumiki - Phony](https://youtu.be/9QLT1Aw_45s)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Blocks]
  - Singer: kafu
- [[Garuna(OwataP) - Gocha Gocha Uruse (2025)](https://youtu.be/HlWA1wncoDs)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Stal]
  - Singer: Akita Neru (Hatsune Miku)
- [[Yoshida Yasei - Override](https://youtu.be/LLjfal8jCYI)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Mall]
  - Singer: Kasane Teto SV
- [[jon-YAKITORY - Konton Boogie](https://youtu.be/1Swg-aBO9eY)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Chirp]
  - Singer: Hatsune Miku
- [[Hiiragi Magnetite - Zako](https://youtu.be/kqj7b59D85Y)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Mellohi]
  - Singer: Akita Neru (Hatsune Miku)
- [[Camellia - Birthright Syndrome](https://youtu.be/OgQc2wSjy3c)]
  - Replaces [C418 - 11]
  - Singer: Hatsune Miku
- [[DECO*27 - Monitoring (Best Friend Remix)](https://youtu.be/C-CYwNz3z8w)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Ward]
  - Singer: Hatsune Miku
- [[YuinaP - Mi Te Ne](https://youtu.be/Is9q9gEwueY)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Far]
  - Singer: Akita Neru (Hatsune Miku) and Kasane Teto SV
- [[Mimizu - feel empty!](https://youtu.be/n1nKVZPd_x4)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Wait]
  - Singer: Kasane Teto SV
- [[Atena - Clone Clone](https://youtu.be/bmbAm-fKnbQ)]
  - Replaces [C418 - Strad]
  - Singer: Kagamine Rin and GUMI

I reccomend installing a client-side mod that fixes the bug where the music stops playing when it's supposed to with the vanilla duration.
Personally, I reccomend [Jukebox Custom Disc Fix](https://modrinth.com/mod/jukebox-custom-disc-fix), but you can find one on your own.

All textures within this resource pack are created by me.

I do not own any rights to any of the music used in this resource pack.

This resource pack may be used in any modpack, as long as it is non-commercial.
